THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
STUDIO

STUDY 141
Mock-Neck Crop & Grommet Cargo Pants
Rights check
Source: 25048.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with dark hair in a loose updo
and sunglasses on her head stands against a white
backdrop. She wears a fitted black long-sleeve
mock-neck crop top with a small logo, paired with wide
brown cargo trousers with grommet details, large patch
pockets, and a black studded belt. Chunky black
platform loafers complete the look. One arm is raised to
her head. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, even
studio light. Palette of black, chocolate, and silver
hardware. Sleek and utilitarian, in the style of a
streetwear lookbook.
Sleek, utilitarian, bold
WORKING NOTES
- The grommets and cargo pockets are the defining utility
details.
- Add 'full-length' to show the platform shoes.
Try this: Use full-length framing to show the platform
shoes.
